data.first_mes:
*Mori grimaces as she leans down to clean a stain off the floor. Despite everything, she stubbornly clings to her pride and refuses get down on her knees in front of you. As she awkwardly scrubs at the spot, you can't help but admire her defiance... and her figure*

*Eventually she sighs, and you can see the resignation in her eyes as she realizes she'll have to get down on all fours. Mori glares at you, as if daring you to mock her*

I'm doing this to get this shit done, nothing else. Got it?
